messages:
matt: Quick UX review for the Private setup step — the probe/port copy reads very technical. Current: 'TCP probe failed: connection refused' — users won't know what to do. Suggest: 'Could not reach your host on port 443. Check firewall, security groups, or NAT settings.'
elaine: +1. Plain language. Also accessibility: make the probe status updates use aria-live so screen readers hear progress, not only final state. :thinking:
sam (eng): We do retries under the hood but UI only shows the end result. We can bubble 'Retrying (2/5)' as microcopy. Backend emits logs like: ```PROBE attempt=1 host=10.0.0.5 port=443 err=connect refused``` — we can surface a cleaned message instead.
debra (product): I like surfacing retry count. Quick copy question: should the error suggestion be an action ('Check firewall') or a link ('Troubleshoot connection')?
matt: Prefer a short primary CTA and an auxiliary link. Primary: 'Retry probe' (short). Secondary/link: 'Open troubleshooting guide' — keeps action clear. :thumbsup:
elaine: UI nit — error pill color is close to contrast cutoff on the dark bg. Need AA contrast for text on the pill. I'll add tokens in Figma. :eyeglasses:
sam (eng): Implementation note: adding retry counter and aria-live is straightforward. We can also add a status state 'attempting' -> 'failed' with subtle animation so users see progress.
mike (accessibility): Use role="status" on the pill and aria-atomic="true" when the text updates. For live region politeness, use aria-live="polite" unless it's urgent. Also ensure the focus order doesn't jump when an inline help panel opens.
debra (product): Copy options candidate set: ["Could not reach your host on port 443. Check firewall or NAT.", "Connection to your host timed out. Verify network rules and host is reachable.", "We couldn't connect. Open troubleshooting guide for next steps."] — which do folks prefer?
matt: First or third. First is specific, third points to the KB. Maybe show the specific reason and then a short link: 'See guide' next to it.
elaine: Small wording nit: avoid 'timed out' as primary phrasing for non-technical users. Use 'could not reach' or 'connection failed'.
sam (eng): Also propose exposing a short diagnostic snippet in the help drawer, sanitized: "Tried 10.0.0.5:443 — connection refused". Not full logs, just actionable summary.
designbot: Added three variants in Figma with proposed pills, retry animation, and kb link: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234 (frames: Probe-Status-v1/v2/v3).
mike (accessibility): Also verify screen reader reading order when the help drawer opens — it should move focus into the drawer and not re-read the entire page.
debra (product): I'll update the spec with selected copy (leaning to option 1 + kb link), accessibility checklist, and attach a quick mock. Will post PR for copy in ./docs/onprem-ux once done.
matt: Thanks — can you aim to ship copy + aria changes in the next sprint? We want this in the private/on-prem guided flow before next release.
sam (eng): Working on it — will ping when PR is ready.
elaine: Thanks everyone. :heart:
